Introduction

Kang Mina is a South Korean actress, dancer, rapper, and singer under Story J Company. She is a former member of the girl group gugudan, its sub-units gugudan SEMINA and OGUOGU, and the project girl group I.O.I.

In 2016, Kang Mina participated in Mnet's survival television show, Produce 101, along with three other trainees from her agency at the time, Jellyfish Entertainment. She ranked 9th overall, qualifying to be a member of the final group I.O.I. She debuted as a member of the group on May 4, 2016, with the release of the mini album 'Chrysalis'. I.O.I released their last song, "DOWNPOUR", on January 18, 2017, and held a concert from January 20 to 22, before eventually disbanding on January 29, 2017.

Kang Mina, along labelmate and fellow I.O.I member Kim Sejeong, debuted as a member of Jellyfish Entertainment's girl group gugudan on June 28, 2016, with the mini album "Act. 1 The Little Mermaid". Later, in July 2017, the agency formed gugudan's first sub-unit, called gugudan OGUOGU, which debuted on August 10, 2017 with the single "ICE CHU", and eventually disbanded after Hyeyeon left the group. Kang Mina was also a part of gugudan' second sub-unit, gugudan SeMiNa, which debuted on July 10, 2018, with the single "SEMINA". Both gugudan and gugudan SeMiNa eventually disbanded in December 2020, after two years of inactivity.

Kang Mina made her acting debut in the MBC romantic comedy series "Children of the 20th Century" in 2017, acting as the younger counterpart of Han Ye-seul.

She has, since gugudan disbandment, focused her career on acting, playing roles in well-known dramas such as "Hotel del Luna" (2019), "Moonshine" (2021-2022), "Café Minamdang" (2022), and "Welcome to Samdalri" (2024-2025).
